summary: The registrant, abrdn Platinum ETF Trust, filed an 8-K reporting a 10-for-1 forward share split for its Physical Platinum Shares ETF (PPLT). The split will apply to shareholders of record as of May 14, 2026, payable after market close on May 15, 2026, and effective pre-market open on May 18, 2026. Post-split shares will trade at one-tenth of pre-split net asset value; ticker and CUSIP remain unchanged. This is a routine capital structure adjustment that does not alter total shareholder value, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors are involved.
